title: Inner child guide: headings for the narrow sidebar

scores.question:
105 of your 147 headings are cut off in the sidebar today. My pick renames them to fit, in your words where they'd go, and keeps your order. Which do you want in the post? Each heading below starts on my pick; change any you like, or use a button. Your answers save as you click. When you're done, tell me in the chat (or press Copy my answers and paste them there), and I'll put them in your post and fix the words in the text that name a renamed heading.

How sure I am: fairly sure the renames help readers; not sure they change where readers land.
